hepatic adenomas associated with fibrolameller carcinoma are HNF1-alpha inactivated adenomas and fibrolamellar cancers are also HNF1-alpha deficient.

hepatic adenomas with fibrolameller carcinoma show LFABP expression loss and are not characterized by PRKACA rearrangement.
